claims: UCLA is favored to defeat UCF in the 2026 NCAA Tournament first round.
Most models project a tight 77-72 or 79-72 victory for UCLA over UCF.
UCLA is roughly 4-6 point favorites over UCF.
UCLA vs. UCF predictions are for March 20, 2026.
Predictions project UCLA as winner with approx. 70-72% chance.
UCLA's superior three-point shooting efficiency and defense are led by Coach Mick Cronin.
UCF relies on a fast-paced game and high three-point volume to generate offense.
UCLA's Donovan Dent is expected to have a major impact as a playmaker.
UCF's Jamichael Stillwell is highlighted as a strong rebounder.
UCLA's Tyler Bilodeau is expected to play despite a knee injury from the Big Ten Tournament.
Analyst Jay Bilas predicts an upset by UCF.
